attribution.decision: Both the learned residual and the zero-command control baseline cause directionally different unsafe behavior; the lower control/plant baseline is not stable enough for an actor-LR-only causal comparison.
attribution.downstream: B0 issues the exact neutral action and produces v_corr=v_final=0 in Z, yet actual body velocity has substantial x/y/z drift and all 32 lanes hit below-height at step 166.
attribution.reset: B0 Z and S synchronize all 32 below-height resets; D7-R S instead has 19 above-height resets beginning at step 314. Initial root state is exactly paired, so initialization mismatch is not the explanation.
attribution.upstream: D7-R maps its deterministic actor mean exactly to a persistent nonzero correction; in Z, mean v_final_z is positive and the vehicle climbs, ending with no reset.

scientific_gate.reason: B0 zero-command baseline fails below-height in all lanes and the B0 job was STOPPED after native app.close hung; the CPU hard-watchdog repair was not live-retested because no second B0 was authorized.
